description: Reference outputs of the official Evo 2 1B path (evo2 0.6.0 + Transformer Engine 2.3.0 FP8) on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060, for examples/evo2_blackwell.ipynb.

arrays.<w>/ids: token ids (CharLevelTokenizer(512): the ASCII code of each base), int16
arrays.<w>/acgt: log-probabilities of A, C, G, T at every position (log_softmax over the 512-token vocabulary of the bf16 logits, in fp32), [L, 4]
arrays.<w>/next: log-probability of the true next token at positions 0..L-2, [L-1]
arrays.brca1/rs, brca1/vs: upstream score_sequences (mean next-token log-likelihood) of the 435 unique reference windows and of the 500 variant windows
arrays.brca1/pos, ref, alt, lof: the 500 variants (hg19 chr17 position, alleles, LOF class) in sample order

windows_source: p0..p3: the four prompts of evo2/test/data/prompts.csv; w8k: the first 8,192 bp of their concatenation; w2k: its first 2,048 bp

brca1.source: Findlay et al. 2018, Supplementary Table (41586_2018_461_MOESM3_ESM.xlsx), via the upstream evo2 BRCA1 notebook
brca1.subset: pandas DataFrame.sample(n=500, random_state=0) of all variants

projection0_w2k.what: block 0 FP8 input projection on window w2k: E4M3 input [2048, 1920], E4M3 weight [5760, 1920], bf16 output [2048, 5760] (sha256 of the raw bytes)

h100_official_te.description: The same official path (evo2 0.6.0 + TE 2.3.0 FP8, same checkpoint and token ids) on an NVIDIA H100 PCIe, compared with the RTX 4060 reference above: how far two GPUs running the official path are apart.
